description: Source code implementing FSIO (Flexible I/O) functionality for GPIO control in an engine management system, including configuration, logic evaluation, and hardware interaction.

classes.name: FsioPointers
classes.description: Holds pointers to FSIO logic elements for GPIO control.

methods.name: getEngineValue
methods.description: Retrieves engine parameter values based on specified action.

methods.name: setFsioAnalogInputPin
methods.description: Configures an analog input pin for FSIO.

methods.name: setFsioDigitalInputPin
methods.description: Configures a digital input pin for FSIO.

methods.name: setFsioPidOutputPin
methods.description: Configures a PID output pin for FSIO.

methods.name: setFsioOutputPin
methods.description: Sets an output pin for FSIO.

methods.name: setFsioExt
methods.description: Sets FSIO configuration with formula and PWM frequency.

methods.name: setFsio
methods.description: Sets FSIO configuration with formula, defaulting to no PWM.

methods.name: applyFsioConfiguration
methods.description: Applies current FSIO configuration to hardware.

methods.name: onConfigurationChangeFsioCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked on FSIO configuration change.

methods.name: getFsioOutputValue
methods.description: Retrieves current output value for a given FSIO channel.

methods.name: handleFsio
methods.description: Handles periodic FSIO logic execution for a channel.

methods.name: action2String
methods.description: Converts FSIO action enum to string.

methods.name: setPinState
methods.description: Sets the state of a GPIO pin based on logic evaluation.

methods.name: setFsioFrequency
methods.description: Sets PWM frequency for an FSIO channel.

methods.name: updateValueOrWarning
methods.description: Updates a value based on logic and warns if invalid.

methods.name: useFsioForServo
methods.description: Updates servo position via FSIO logic.

methods.name: runFsio
methods.description: Main periodic function to update FSIO outputs and logic.

methods.name: showFsio
methods.description: Displays FSIO logic state for debugging.

methods.name: showFsioInfo
methods.description: Displays current FSIO configuration and status.

methods.name: setFsioSetting
methods.description: Sets a user-configurable FSIO setting.

methods.name: setFsioExpression
methods.description: Sets a custom logic expression for FSIO output.

methods.name: rpnEval
methods.description: Evaluates a reverse polish notation expression.

methods.name: initFsioImpl
methods.description: Initializes FSIO subsystem, including logic elements and configuration.
